name: agent-swarm
description: Orchestrate independent agents across Codex and WorkBuddy to deliver one task end to end, with leaderboard-ranked expert recruitment and independent verification.

interface.shortDescription: One sentence in, verified delivery out
interface.longDescription: Decomposes a single request into independently verifiable subtasks, dispatches parallel agents in isolated worktrees across both hosts, recruits external experts by popularity leaderboard, consumes only PASS/FAIL verdicts, and keeps durable state on disk so any new session can resume.
defaultPrompt: 帮我完成这个任务，你自己拆解、自己派人、自己验收，中途不用问我。
用热度榜里最合适的专家来做这件事，并说明你为什么选它、备胎是谁。
接手上一阶段的进度：读取 .swarm/HANDOFF.md 和 brief.json 后继续推进。
